base_url.description: Direct target override for local lab runs, for example https://pve.example.com:8006. Central assignments should use credential rules and SRQL-scoped targets.

credential_broker.description: Internal credential broker grant generated from network credential rules. Do not configure manually.

api_token_secret_ref.description: Internal network credential reference resolved into api_token only in scoped agent runtime config.

targets.description: Credential-rule compiled Proxmox targets. Credentials are resolved by the edge credential broker.

max_response_bytes.description: Maximum bytes returned by one proxied Proxmox API call. Raise this for very large clusters.
